subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to Katheryne in Sumeru City

30160101.text: Ad astra abyssosque! We meet again, you two.

30160102.text: Hi Katheryne, do you have any commissions for us today?

30160103.text: Commissions, huh? Hmmm, let me think...

30160104.text: Oh, how about this? Please attend the Akademiya's academic symposium this afternoon, and recite a love poem onstage.

30160106.text: And if possible, please also use your Kamera to capture the reaction of the audience upon finishing the poem.

30160107.text: Huh? What kind of commission is that?

30160110.text: I see... It appears that you're not interested in this commission.

30160111.text: In that case, please go to Port Ormos and convince the Eremites there to spend some time volunteering at the local orphanage.

subQuests.subQuestName: Continue talking to Nahida somewhere else

30162101.text: I can't think of anything else.

30161720.text: Hmm... Are we really out of ideas?

30161721.text: Nahida, you're super smart, so you already have something in mind, right? Don't keep us in suspense — spill the beans already!

30161722.text: According to a popular theory from the Vahumana Darshan of the Akademiya, rejecting impractical motions at the beginning of a planning session will give more weight to the actual proposal.

30161723.text: Okay, okay, but aren't you the God of Wisdom? You don't have to use that kind of gimmick to make us take your ideas seriously.

30161724.text: Well, I've been thinking that if I can't directly possess the leaders, and if I can't get ordinary people involved...

30161725.text: Then I should find someone who's already involved, but hasn't decided to side with the sages.

30161726.text: You're saying we should recruit a spy? Hmm, that does sound like it could work.

30161727.text: Oh! Before coming back, we met someone named Alhaitham. He seems like he acts alone, and he likes doing stuff behind the Akademiya's back. They probably aren't in cahoots.

30161728.text: Actually, I already have someone in mind. Do you still remember that female scholar named Setaria?

30161729.text: Setaria... Paimon remembers now! Isn't she the one who's always trailing behind the Grand Sage of the Akademiya?

30161730.text: We ran into her basically every time the Sabzeruz Festival repeated itself. You could even say we're old enemies by now...

30161731.text: Paimon still remembers the smug and mean way she always spoke to Nilou!

30161732.text: Mm-hmm. I've always liked observing all kinds of people, and Setaria has always stood out from the crowd.

30161733.text: She was born in the desert, and was hailed as their greatest genius. Her academic gifts allowed her special admission into the Akademiya, and also gave her the opportunity to serve as the sages' assistant.

30161734.text: Oh, Paimon didn't know she was from the desert! She must be pretty special, then. Paimon feels like most of the desert-dwellers around the city are working as mercenaries.

30161735.text: The name Setaria means "star." When she lived in the desert, she shone like the brightest star in the night sky.

30161736.text: Later on, she was chosen by the Sun. The star was given a place in the daytime sky to complement the Sun's dazzling light.

30161737.text: Soon after, the star witnessed the Sun scorching the earth, which brought forth many disasters.

30161738.text: The star began to waver. Instead of staying beside such a sun, wouldn't it be better to return and light up part of the night sky?

30161739.text: But in the end, she couldn't give up the radiance of daytime. To cope with her shame, the star buried her guilt and closed her eyes...

30161742.text: From the sound of it, Setaria's just hung up on the research opportunities here...

30161743.text: But she doesn't really support the Akademiya. She still feels guilty about not doing more for the desert, right...? She's just running away from her problems!

30161744.text: Indeed. When they are presented with complex moral issues, many people will simply plug their ears and go with the flow until the problem can't be fixed anymore.

30161745.text: She's suppressing a lot of guilt, but before she realized it, she had already become the sages' accomplice. She can't deny her part in their schemes anymore.

30161746.text: Sounds exactly like the person we need.

30161747.text: Right. We must somehow make her face her problems again...

30161748.text: That way, not only can we get useful intel from her, but she can also use it as an opportunity to redeem herself.

30161749.text: From my past observations, Setaria will take a day off from the Akademiya every ten days to do some shopping in the city.

30161750.text: Tomorrow afternoon just happens to be a shopping day for her. That'll be our chance.

30161751.text: To prepare, let's go check out some of her favorite spots, and have a quick chat with a few of the vendors there.

subQuests.subQuestName: Gather information as instructed by Nahida

30160201.text: This should be Setaria's favorite fortune-telling spot.

30160202.text: Uh... so, should we ask the fortune-teller about Setaria?

30160203.text: No, I already have enough information on Setaria. The most important thing now is for you to pay attention to the vendor's talking style and key characteristics.

30160205.text: My poor lost lambs, have you become troubled over your fates?

30160206.text: The divine voice of wisdom often echoes between mine ears. If thou be blessed today by the gods, I may be able to show you the way.

30160207.text: Huh, really? Nahida, you've been whispering things to her?

30160208.text: #Shh... Ahem, my friend here has some doubts regarding {F#her}{M#his} future. Can we get a fortune reading for {F#her}{M#him}?

30160209.text: Hummm... of course, of course. In that case...

30160211.text: Oho, it would seem that Harut and Marut are quite wary of you. Perhaps at some time in the past, you have somehow offended the gods?

30160212.text: Only mocking the God of Anemo, questioning the Lord of Geo's financial savviness, and brawling with the God of Electro... Do those count?

30160214.text: #Oh, nothing. {NICKNAME}, go on, pick an aspect for her to divine.

30160216.text: Health prospects? No problem at all.

30160218.text: Hummm... The gods have spoken. The truth shall be revealed.

30160219.text: Your life shall continue on for... for... Huh!? Many... many tens of thousands of years!? Impossible...

30160225.text: Harut, Marut, did you two spoil my divination? I've never read a fortune so absurd.

30160227.text: Uhh, actually, Paimon thinks this is probably the most accurate fortune-telling you've ever done...

30160228.text: Ahem, I admit that the orientation of today's celestial matrix is suboptimal. As such, there will be no charge.

30160229.text: Is that so... Well, that can't be helped.

30160230.text: If you were to bring some food offerings for Harut and Marut on your next visit, perhaps they could help you reverse the wheels of fate?

30160221.text: Love prospects? No problem at all.

30160223.text: Hummm... The gods have spoken. The truth shall be revealed.

30160224.text: One who is fated to cross your path will appear on... on... Huh!? So... so many people will fall for you!? How could that be...

subQuests.subQuestName: Gather information as instructed by Nahida

30160301.text: Is this another one of Setaria's favorite stalls?

30160302.text: Yep. It belongs to Akim. His father helped Setaria a lot when she first moved to Sumeru City, so she still comes by whenever she has time.

30160303.text: When I start talking with him, listen carefully to the details of our conversation.

30160304.text: Ah, dear customers, would you like to look at some pottery?

30160305.text: We caught wind of your great craftsmanship, so we specifically came to take a look.

30160306.text: Oh! I recognize you. Aren't you Miss Katheryne from the Adventurers' Guild? Sounds like I'm in for some big business!

30160307.text: Speaking of, where did you learn this trade?

30160308.text: I suppose you could say it all started with my dad. He's a mason by trade, but I picked up an interest in clay while apprenticing for him.

30160309.text: After that, I began making pottery by myself in secret, and I simply changed trades when my works turned out well. Although, it's a pity that I'm no longer making much use of the knowledge provided to me by the Akasha...

30160310.text: That's nice! You're making a living doing something you love!

30160311.text: Hmm, so is your father still working as a mason?

30160312.text: Oh no, not anymore. A few years back, he fell from a roof and broke his leg. Since he had already saved enough Mora over all these years, he's just enjoying the retired life in Port Ormos nowadays.

30160313.text: I see. We wish him peace and happiness in his retirement.

30160314.text: I'll have someone in charge of logistics at the guild come by another day for some goods. We'll leave you to it. Take care now!

30160315.text: No problem. Rest easy, all our goods are sure to meet your every need.

subQuests.subQuestName: Gather information as instructed by Nahida

30160401.text: This should be our final stop. Setaria is always thinking of this restaurant when she's working at the Akademiya, so she always comes by whenever she's out in the city.

30160402.text: Nahida, you've really thought of everything!

30160403.text: Hehe, it's my duty to protect Sumeru's citizens, after all.

30160404.text: Hi there. I feel like I've seen you down by the docks before...

30160405.text: Huh? Sorry, I don't quite remember...

30160406.text: If I recall, you were having a discussion with someone about ship-building at the time.

30160407.text: Ah, that's right! I've always been really interested in feats of marine engineering.

30160408.text: After all, I grew up in Liyue Harbor and spent my entire childhood staring at the ships going in and out of the port. I came to Sumeru to study, but failed to make it into the Akademiya due to my lack of talent.

30160409.text: But I'm still discussing all kinds of problems with different scholars, and I'm continuing to study and perform research from the restaurant's basement. I'm sure I'll get into the Akademiya after their next round of exams!

30160410.text: What an admirable spirit for learning. Amazing!

30160411.text: Sure... But you'll find hard-working people wherever you go!

30160412.text: So this restaurant has a basement as well? Huh, first I've heard of it.

30160413.text: That's right! It's not usually open to patrons. Most of the time, employees use it for breaks or to hold private events.

30160414.text: I see... Guess that makes sense. Well, good luck with your studies, Miss Qishan.

30160415.text: Haha, thank you so much. As long as I can make it into the Akademiya as an official student, I'll be happy.

30160502.text: Mm-hmm. Three familiar faces should be enough for Setaria.

30160503.text: What's the point of all the information we've collected? Nahida, you still haven't told us how you're planning to make Setaria face her problems.

30160504.text: Setaria is already used to avoiding her problems, so we must find a way to break through her usual sensibilities.

30160505.text: I remember you mentioned that the Eremites in Port Ormos are all making a fuss about the upcoming resurrection of King Deshret.

30160506.text: Although it's all just a boatload of nonsense, the faith of her homeland may turn out to be Setaria's soft spot.

30160507.text: Oh, Paimon gets it now... You want to take advantage of the guilt Setaria feels about her homeland.

30160508.text: Although she knows she should return home to help the people of the desert, all she's done is conspire with the sages...

30160511.text: Hmm, so how do we set that up?

30160512.text: Well, King Deshret is long gone, and Setaria is also too smart to fall for any simple tricks...

30160513.text: If we simply engaged her under the guise of King Deshret's believers, she'd definitely be wary of us, and we may not get anywhere.

30160514.text: But if we were to "borrow" some of her close acquaintances to talk with her... her reaction would probably be very different.

30160515.text: So you mean, you're going to possess those people we just talked to?

30160516.text: Yep. Possess them through the Akasha, imply that they've already converted to the faith of King Deshret, and then convey our made-up "will of King Deshret."

30160517.text: As long as everything goes smoothly, we'll get through to Setaria for sure. She'll never guess that we had anything to do with it.

30160518.text: Ahh, so that's how you're going to use all the info we collected on these people — it's so that you won't slip up and break form! Possessing them will only work if you can manage to pass off as them.

30160519.text: Exactly! So, best of luck with impersonating them.

30160520.text: Huh? Best of luck? B—But we don't know how to possess anyone!

30160521.text: That's no problem at all. I'll just share all their senses with you once I've possessed them. As long as you're also wearing an Akasha Terminal, the effect will basically be as if you've possessed them yourself.

30160522.text: #Huh, that is pretty convenient... But why does {F#she}{M#he} have to do this? Can't you do it yourself?

30160523.text: Although I've been observing humans for a while, I've never been good at imitating them...

30160524.text: Hmm, you're not wrong... It's always been painfully obvious whenever you try to pass as Katheryne.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the market and carry out Nahida's plan

30160701.text: Ooh, here she comes! Setaria's here!

30160702.text: Let's quietly follow her. Once she starts talking to her acquaintances, we'll find a safe spot to begin possessing them.

30160703.text: #As for how we'll sway her to our side... I'll leave that to you. {NICKNAME}, I trust you'll know what to say.

30160704.text: Ahh, Paimon's starting to feel kinda nervous! Okay, let's go!

30160705.text: Looks like they've already started talking... Let's find a hiding spot and get started!

30160706.text: ...That's right, you really can't force anything when it comes to love. And besides, everyone around me has a very different background and outlook...

30160707.text: Huh? Are you still listening to me, Nabiya?

30160708.text: Oh, o—of course I'm listening! You were talking about troubles with your love life, right? I heard everything you said.

30160709.text: Ah, okay then. You just seemed a little distracted for a moment there.

30160711.text: Strange... Your cats seem pretty worked up. Is something wrong?

30160712.text: I always thought they were quiet, happy kitties... Oh, what are their names again?

30160714.text: Hmm, are you sure? Those aren't ringing a bell for some reason...

30160715.text: Ah, well... A—Actually, they have many names. Which names I use depends on my mood.

30160716.text: Huh, I see. I imagine that must be hard for the kitties, too.

30160719.text: Ahem, so which fortune do you want me to read for you today? You must have come for another echo of the divine voice of wisdom.

30160720.text: Hmm... I'd like to get another reading on my love prospects, but to be perfectly honest with you, I feel like I've been a real mess recently...

30160722.text: Well, erm... Could you do a reading on how long it'll take me to finish my current project at work? I really just want to get it over with...

30160723.text: I hear you... No problem at all. Uh, the gods will reveal the truth.

30160718.text: Ahh, that's right! They are just little darlings, aren't they? Harut and Marut...

subQuests.subQuestName: Wait for Nahida to enter the inhabitant's consciousness and talk to Setaria

30160901.text: ...It's okay, I just got caught up in something.

30160902.text: Oh, actually, didn't you ask me to help you look for work? What kind of work were you looking for again?

30160904.text: Gardening? But don't you hate everything to do with plants? I still remember getting mad at you for secretly throwing away the bonsai that I gave you as a present.

30160905.text: Erm... Well, uh, you see, a friend told me that the secret to self-improvement is to work on things you're not so good at.

30160906.text: ...Fair enough. I didn't think that was something you would consider.

30160909.text: Speaking of, how's he doing? Is he feeling any better?

30160908.text: Oh, right, your old man's craft... How could I forget?

subQuests.subQuestName: Wait for Nahida to enter the inhabitant's consciousness and talk to Setaria

30161101.text: ...So, Qishan, have you noticed anything weird in the city lately?

30161102.text: Like... as if someone was trying to preach to you about something.

30161107.text: Oh right, speaking of strange things...

30161108.text: I celebrated the Sabzeruz Festival so many times that I lost count. That was really weird.

30161109.text: Wait, how could you be aware of that!? That should be impossible. Nothing in the report indicated anything like that...

30161110.text: Are you still failing to realize that the Akademiya's lowly tricks could never deceive all of Sumeru's citizens?

30161112.text: ...Qishan, don't tell me that you've converted to King Deshret as well?

30161113.text: What an absurd question. You make it sound like I should be ashamed for becoming a believer of King Deshret.

30161114.text: In reality, shouldn't you be the one who is ashamed? You, who worked side-by-side with the Akademiya and treated people as nothing more than experimental subjects?

30161116.text: Even now, Setaria's still trying to run from her problems...

30161118.text: She can no longer justify everything to herself...

30161119.text: Hey, she's trying to talk to the guards! What should we do?

30161120.text: This is the most important part of all. Quick, get ready!

30161121.text: ...Mercenary, you're a member of the Corps of Thirty, correct? Please help me pass a message to the matra right away. The situation in the city is getting out of control...

30161122.text: Please, try to remain calm, miss. Tell me, what's happening in the city?

30161123.text: Heretics are infiltrating the city, and they've already converted many residents to their side...

30161124.text: Heretics? What kind of heresy are you talking about?

30161125.text: King Deshret! Many people I know have suddenly started believing in him, but he's long dead... It's impossible...

30161128.text: King Deshret is immortal, and all who defy him will one day pay the price.

30161129.text: You must face the truth, Setaria. You tread a treacherous path, and the longer you ignore it, the tighter the Akademiya's grasp on you will become, and the deeper you will be ensnared.

30161130.text: Child of King Deshret, never forget that the desert that belongs to you lies elsewhere.

30161132.text: *sigh* ...It seems that no matter where I run, I only keep finding more believers of King Deshret. I have to say, this is a familiar feeling...

30161133.text: I've also been running from my guilt this whole time... Guilt over my part in the sages' plans, and from ignoring the letters from the children of my homeland.

30161134.text: But no matter how much I may try to ignore or get rid of it, my guilt always comes back.

30161105.text: Wait, did you just say attic? I thought this place didn't have an attic... Also, don't you usually study in the basement?

30161106.text: Uh, well... The restaurant recently added an attic. I've been studying there because it has better lighting.

30161201.text: I've never seen Harut and Marut be so wary of anyone...

30161301.text: Katheryne, we're here! Oh, hmm... You're the "other" Katheryne, right?

30161302.text: That's right. I suppose I'm the "other Katheryne" in your mind.

30161303.text: Can't we just call her Nahida?

30161304.text: Shh...! We're on a secret mission tonight, so we need to protect Katheryne's identity!

30161305.text: Yep, Paimon's right. We cannot fully rule out the chance that the meet-up tonight is just a trap.

30161306.text: If something were to happen, my existence may be the only trump card we'll be able to play.

30161307.text: After all, the Akademiya should still be unable to confirm the existence of my consciousness in the outside world.

30161308.text: Yep, yep! Exactly, just what Paimon was thinking!

30161310.text: Ugh... Anyway, enough about that! Let's just make sure to be on our guard!

30161313.text: Off? What do you feel is off?

30161314.text: It's just a little too quiet around here.

30161315.text: It's the middle of the night — of course it's quiet! You're not getting paranoid, are you?

30161316.text: #No, I think {NICKNAME}'s right. It really is a lot quieter than usual.

30161317.text: If you look around, there seems to be fewer people on the streets. I'm not sure if this is the case for the entire city, though...

30161318.text: Huh, maybe it's just a coincidence? Maybe Setaria figured out a way to not only distract the guards, but also to get everyone to go to sleep early, just so we can exchange the documents in peace.

30161319.text: I also can't quite figure out why things feel a little off... But, now that we're here, let's go ahead and meet her as we planned.

30161320.text: Well, regardless... as long as you're here with us, Paimon feels a little safer!

subQuests.subQuestName: Sort out the information you have

30161601.text: This should be far enough... Phew, Paimon needs to catch her breath first.

30161602.text: Is Nahida going to be okay? We only made it out because of her...

30161605.text: Paimon wasn't counting on running into a new Harbinger here, let alone such a high-ranking one! That guy was number two... so scary...

30161606.text: He called himself "The Doctor"... Remember Tighnari told us about him. Setaria did say that someone who once got expelled from the Akademiya came back recently...

30161607.text: ...and that even the sages are wary of him. Yep, sounds like she must've been talking about The Doctor.

30161702.text: Okay. So do you have any ideas on how we can investigate the sages, Nahida?

30161703.text: Actually, I've already done a little bit of work on that, but for now, I want to hear your thoughts.

30161801.text: Possess a key figure in the Akademiya?

30161802.text: I've already tried that, but all the key members of the Akademiya — even the Corps of Thirty guards — intentionally avoid wearing their Akasha Terminals.

30161803.text: It seems that from the very beginning, they've been guarding against info leaks from the Akasha. Of course, it could also be because they're wary of me.

30161804.text: Have you already caught the sages' attention?

30161805.text: I'm guessing not yet, but distrusting me would make perfect sense if they ever paid attention to the urban legends about me.

30161806.text: In any case, I probably can't take over their minds directly.

30161901.text: Possess a student and infiltrate the sages' quarters?

30161903.text: You mean it'd be too easy to get caught?

30161904.text: No, it's not that. We shouldn't involve innocent students in this. A single mistake could completely ruin their lives.

30161905.text: Doing that would be ignoring the safety of my people for my own selfish goals. How is that any different from what the sages are doing?

30161906.text: That's a good point. Spoken like the God of Sumeru!

30162001.text: We could grab someone close to the sages and question them?

30162002.text: We're in the dark as of now. Since we still don't know anything about their goals, any rash move could tip them off and lead to terrible consequences.

30162003.text: After all, every person in Sumeru City is one of their hostages.

30162601.text: That was my first time talking with Miss Katheryne. Hehe, I'm sure I sounded a bit nervous...

30162801.text: I must have met her somewhere. Why can't I remember?

30162901.text: Huh? What's gotten into Harut and Marut? They seem terrified of me all of a sudden...

30163001.text: Whoa... What happened just now? Wasn't I talking with Setaria? Where'd she go?

30163101.text: *yawn* I seem to have dozed off just now... Maybe I studied way too late last night? Ah, I'm sorry, can I help you with anything?

30169901.text: We've spent quite some time in Sumeru City, but ever since we last said goodbye to Lesser Lord Kusanali, we haven't heard anything from her...

30169902.text: *sigh* We can't just keep waiting around like this. Let's go find Katheryne and pick up some work so we can at least keep ourselves busy!

30169903.text: She's at Akim's now, right on cue! Let's get ready to possess him right away!

30169904.text: #C'mon {NICKNAME}! Setaria's already started talking with Qishan!

30169905.text: Huh, there really aren't many people out right now... Let's hope it'll be this quiet in front of the Akademiya, and that Setaria managed to distract all the guards...
